body: Sandeep Taneja (CFO) on the Q2FY27 call (2026-11-05), volunteered: "We are looking at capex of around INR60 crores to be spent over next year. Most of these are approved and advances have been paid." Metric: Capex next 12 months. Target: ~INR 60 cr. Deadline: 2027-11-30 (fiscal-year). Specificity: precise. Status as of 2026-11-19: PENDING. Evidence: Above the '2.5-3.5% of revenue, we will not be deviating' line of 2026-05-26; the CEO now calls it 'about 4% of our revenue because there is growth'. A goalpost shift to watch, though growth capex in an upturn is defensible.
